rv.q: Darkling is a worthy reminder of an often-overlooked disaster – but one that may well fail to take root in the mind.
A harrowing and intriguing account of a young woman’s struggles in the face of much adversity.
But it’s the overall tone that is difficult.
The emotion captured through the design elements of this production is simply incredible.

cn.t: Berthelsen delivers a tour de force performance in this poetic monologue about the 1984 Bhopal disaster, though critics are divided on whether the script fully captures the catastrophe's horror and scale.
